{"search_note":"I searched directly for:
- `Erdogan 2024 disarmament`
- `Erdogan 2024 nonproliferation`
- `Turkey 2024 arms control`
- `Erdogan 2024 de-escalation agreement`
- `Erdogan 2024 NATO disarmament`

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence that Erdoğan:
- negotiated or signed a new arms-control treaty,
- accepted a new inspection regime,
- advanced formal nonproliferation commitments,
- or made a clear public statement about disarmament architecture in treaty terms.

So the best-supported reading for **1B.4** is **partial support through restraint/de-escalation rhetoric**, with **no strong direct treaty-level evidence** and some countervailing leverage-heavy rhetoric.","evidence":[{"title":"Türkiye President - Recep Tayyip Erdoğan - Statement summary (excerpts on the situation in oPT) - UN General Assembly - 79th Session","publisher":"UN / UNISPAL","date":"2024-09-24","url":"https://www.un.org/unispal/document/turkiye-president-recep-tayyip-unga-79-24sep24/","summary":"Erdoğan’s UNGA remarks centered on stopping the Gaza war, preventing further escalation, and pushing for Security Council action. This is not a formal arms-control agreement, but it is clear de-escalation-oriented rhetoric.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Turkey opposes Ukraine use of US long-range missiles, urges restraint","publisher":"Reuters via Reuters-syndicated reporting","date":"2024-11-20","url":"https://www.ekathimerini.com/politics/foreign-policy/1253952/erdogan-opposes-ukraine-use-of-us-long-range-missiles-urges-restraint/","summary":"Erdoğan argued that enabling deeper strikes into Russia would intensify the war and provoke a harsher response. By inference, this supports restraint and de-escalation in a nuclear-sensitive conflict.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Turkey’s Erdogan says wants deeper ties with Egypt on natural gas, nuclear energy","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-09-04","url":"https://theprint.in/world/erdogan-says-turkey-wants-deeper-ties-with-egypt-on-natural-gas-nuclear-energy/2253082/","summary":"Erdoğan discussed nuclear energy only as civilian cooperation. That is weak but relevant evidence that he did not frame nuclear issues as weapons, coercion, or proliferation.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.3","1B.2"]},{"title":"Erdogan says Turkey will not approve NATO attempts to cooperate with Israel","publisher":"Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications / Reuters syndication","date":"2024-07-12","url":"https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/english/haberler/detay/erdogan-says-turkey-will-not-approve-nato-attempts-to-cooperate-with-israel","summary":"Erdoğan tied approval to a comprehensive peace in Palestine. This is peace-linked, but it also shows tactical blocking leverage rather than straightforward support for cooperative de-escalation architecture.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Erdogan says Turkey might “enter Israel” as it had Libya and Nagorno-Karabakh","publisher":"Reuters via VOA","date":"2024-07-28","url":"https://www.voanews.com/a/erdogan-says-turkey-might-enter-israel-to-help-palestinians/7716248.html","summary":"Erdoğan used an overt interventionist threat in a defense-industry setting. This does not mention nuclear weapons, but it is inconsistent with careful, good-faith de-escalation rhetoric.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Turkey’s Erdogan hopes Trump will tell Israel to stop war","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-11-08","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/turkeys-erdogan-hopes-trump-will-tell-israel-to-stop-war-3710867","summary":"Erdoğan called for outside pressure on Israel to stop the war. This is pro-ceasefire in substance, but it is still high-pressure rhetoric rather than evidence of treaty-based arms-control behavior.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.1"]}]}
